name: com.basis.integration.metabodytracking
description: Full-body tracking straight from Meta's OpenXR body tracking extensions (XR_FB_body_tracking plus the META full-body, fidelity and calibration extensions). The headset's own estimate of hips, chest, elbows, knees and feet is surfaced as ordinary Basis trackers, so a Quest drives full body with no physical trackers at all. Works on standalone and over Link, and stays inert on runtimes that do not expose the extensions.
